component.name: CS:GO Legacy Server
component.summary: Host a CS:GO Legacy dedicated server with bots
Monta un servidor dedicado de CS:GO Legacy contra bots

description.p: Download, set up and run a CS:GO Legacy (app 740) dedicated server from one window, with game modes from a community hub to play against bots, SourceMod plugins compiled automatically, a custom mode editor and a workshop map browser.

Descarga, configura y arranca un servidor dedicado de CS:GO Legacy (app 740) desde una ventana, con más de treinta modos contra bots, plugins de SourceMod que se compilan solos, editor de modos propios y buscador de mapas del workshop.

ul.li: Start, stop and change mode or map live
Kick, ban and see each player's skins
LAN, friends over VPN, internet or Steam community server profiles
Workshop search; CS2-only maps are flagged as incompatible
Command line tool for headless servers

screenshot.caption: Server status, live match controls and presets
Live console with filters and aliases

description.p: Play and Join now enter the server by themselves, deathmatch bots move and respawn, the VPN bridge is easier to use and can be tested, and there are eight more match types.
Fix: the "Create a server" button did nothing on first launch.
First release: GTK app and command line, replacing the old shell scripts.
